decisive_items: Alveolar lavage fluid mNGS: Detected TW with sequence number 36543 and abundance 0.43%
Lung puncture biopsy: Positive PAS staining
Chest CT: Multiple nodular and patchy high-density shadows in both lungs, with some foci of solid lesions
response.rationale: mNGS detection of TW plus positive PAS staining on lung biopsy strongly indicates a fungal etiology, supported by bilateral pulmonary infiltrates and acute respiratory symptoms. Other candidates lack specific microbiologic or pathologic confirmation.

rejected.why: Nonspecific pneumonia label; does not incorporate mNGS/PAS fungal evidence.
No influenza-specific testing support; respiratory pathogen nucleic acid was normal.
No immunosuppression, normal β-D-glucan, and mNGS detected TW rather than Pneumocystis.
Leukocytosis is present, but PAS-positive biopsy and mNGS favor fungal rather than bacterial pneumonia.
T-spot negative and prior TB was cured; mNGS did not detect Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
History of old cured TB alone is insufficient; active TB is not supported by T-spot or mNGS.
Clinically consistent with pneumonia but less etiologically specific than fungal pneumonia.
Bilateral pulmonary infiltrates indicate pneumonia, not isolated acute bronchitis.
